scope: native Windows cold-profile preservation and bounded boat-maintenance tooling checks

checks: Captures and completes a hash-bound, preservation-only cold profile baseline without changing the live fixture profile.
Exercises native Get-Acl/Set-Acl behavior: a foreign Everyone read ACE is refused by the cold reader, and restoring the original ACL restores valid lineage.
Runs Inventory, Prepare, Apply, InspectRestore and Restore against disposable files and confirms captured profile bytes are restored without launch authority.
Refuses active transactions, live-process fixture state, context drift, profile races, changed review inputs and partial completion publication.
substitutedBoundaries: official-stock identity for one exact inert fixture executable

supportingNativeEvidence.scope: restart broker and Prepare/Arm native protocol fixtures
native guarded window and display review
native commissioning restart transport and process fixtures
supportingNativeEvidence.checks: 886 commissioning restart protocol checks; 87 marker publication checks; 384 checks across 24 native restart cases

limits: Cold-baseline checks operate on disposable temporary files, not the boat PC or an actual user profile.
The checks do not accept a live cold capture, perform product acceptance, or establish boat, hardware, or marine-operation readiness.
The cold-baseline happy path uses empty plugin roots; nonempty plugin restoration is exercised by the accompanying native commissioning and baseline-adoption maintenance reports.
unmetGates: Root-run live cold capture evidence and review on the intended boat PC.
Remaining product, installer/update, release, and public-beta acceptance gates.
